title: cleanup_tmp_files and cleanup_orphan_msg_files use inconsistent filename matching
description: cleanup_tmp_files uses file_name().ends_with() to match .msg.tmp and .env.tmp (correct for compound extensions). cleanup_orphan_msg_files uses path.extension() == 'msg' (correct for simple extension). The inconsistency will confuse future contributors: a contributor adding a new file type will see two different patterns and may copy the wrong one, getting a subtle file-matching bug. One canonical pattern should be chosen and used throughout.
